projection_rules: The projection is exactly the object above, with the given member names; pointer/object/literal directives are specification notation and are not included in the hashed value. Resolve every pointer without default values.

expectedGrant is JSON null only when the referenced grantContext is null; otherwise construct precisely the listed members. Preserve JSON types, array order and explicit nulls. No Unicode normalization.
Parameters and participants are copied in full, including originalTargetCallBytes for cancellation: those target bytes remain inert and never replace the executing cancel call.
observedMilestoneState in expectedGrant binds the reviewed precondition. Fresh current state belongs in Snapshot/observations; rewriting the reviewed predicate changes the plan.

Exclude every other envelope member: recordId, digest, status, anchor, derivedFromRecordDigest, evidence, summaryText, requiredGateIds and callTree; exclude expectedState.snapshotDigest/localReviewExpiresAtUnixSeconds/localExpiryRevokesNativeProposal and fresh grant observedRound/scopeStatus/historyComplete/evidence; exclude outer fee estimates/budget, multisigInnerMaxWeight and estimationEvidence.

Excluded callTree, summary and gate lists are never trusted shortcuts: independently derive them from the canonical catalogue and compare exact bytes under SG-13 before any request. Changes to excluded outer-attempt values require renewed exact wallet review and context, not mutation of an existing request.
semantic_intent_identity.conflict_rule: Within all locally held or imported sealed envelopes, the same intentId and intentRevision must have one semanticIntentDigest and the same independently recomputed projection. Different content under that key is quarantined as SemanticIntentConflict, never last-writer-wins. An importer cannot clear a conflict by supplying a claimed digest.
semantic_intent_identity.revision_rule: Assign first sealed revision 1. Changed semantic content requires a strictly higher positive decimal intentRevision for that intentId, or a new intentId with supersedesIntentId lineage. Old revisions, requests, native proposal generations and approvals remain immutable; revision increment does not revoke them or carry approvals to changed bytes. No global uniqueness or exclusivity is claimed.
semantic_intent_identity.observation_rule: Observation/status/review-time refresh appends a new full recordId/digest/derivedFromRecordDigest while retaining the same semantic digest if the projection is unchanged. SignedAttempt.envelopeDigest and LocalOperationProgress.envelopeDigest always identify the exact reviewed immutable envelope, not a moving latest pointer.
semantic_intent_identity.draft_rule: An unsealed draft may have semanticIntentDigest=null and cannot prompt a wallet. Before frozen/approved or any signing, seal and recompute the semantic digest, validate all typed bytes and reject conflicts. Once a key is sealed it cannot be reused with changed content, even if later displayed as draft.
semantic_intent_identity.revision_compatibility: Missing or unknown localContractRevision is nonexecutable migration input, even when schemaVersion is 2. Rebuild with new identities/digests and provenance; no inferred approval.
